entries.reason: v5 escapes event titles twice, so a title or link label shows an entity such as &; the app shows it once, as text. The v5 side's titles and link labels are unescaped once before comparing, so the app's must equal the unescaped v5 value exactly; this entry covers only the per-event record that v5 showed an entity and the app did not.

entries.reason: v5 keys the Info Required done flags and the enforcement step statuses by array position in the imported lists, so a reordered list moves them to other items. ClearCase keys each by a digest of the item's own content and reports a flag or status whose item left the version instead of moving it (S-info_required_tab-1, S-enforcement_tab-1). Evidence: tests/analysis/info-required.test.ts:31.
entries.author: GRS-67 dispositions (scripts/verify/register-dispositions.mjs)

entries.reason: v5 escapes an event's link label twice, so a title with an ampersand or angle bracket shows literal entity text. ClearCase cleans the title and shows it once, as a text node, so the characters appear as typed. Parity sees the change: IDR-167. Evidence: src/lib/views/analysis/timeline.test.ts:45.
entries.author: GRS-67 dispositions (scripts/verify/register-dispositions.mjs)

entries.reason: v5 hard-codes case narrative, counts and a firm name in the renderer. ClearCase fills the synopsis, narrative, trajectory and notes from the imported view-content dataset, with counts derived from the register and package, so no case wording lives in code. entries.author: GRS-67 dispositions (scripts/verify/register-dispositions.mjs)

entries.reason: v5 scales year bars by the maximum, so a map of only zero counts divides by zero and gives NaN heights. ClearCase takes the maximum with a zero floor and draws flat bars for all-zero counts and none for an empty map. Evidence: src/lib/views/analysis/timeline.test.ts:23.
entries.author: GRS-67 dispositions (scripts/verify/register-dispositions.mjs)

entries.reason: v5 trusts the high-severity count and per-category counts from the dataset instead of deriving them. ClearCase copies this and shows the package's own figures, so a package whose counts disagree with its categories shows inconsistent KPIs; deriving them would be an app change. Evidence: src/routes/v/[vid]/analysis/contradictions_tab/+page.svelte:35.
